problem: A school is laying turf on a rectangular soccer field for the little kids. The field measures 30 yards by 12 yards. How many square yards of turf are needed?
follow_up_questions: The big kids' field beside it is 85 square yards larger. How many square yards is the big kids' field?
How many square yards do both fields cover altogether?
A worker spreads one bag of fertilizer on every 5 square yards. How many bags are needed for both fields?

problem: In a community garden, Mrs. Adeyemi digs a vegetable bed shaped like a rectangle. It is 12 yards wide and 30 yards long. Find the area of the bed in square yards.
follow_up_questions: A flower bed nearby has an area 85 square yards greater than the vegetable bed. What is the flower bed's area?
Find the combined area of the vegetable bed and the flower bed.
Mulch is spread at one wheelbarrow load per 5 square yards. How many loads cover both beds?

problem: An art teacher wants to paint a mural wall that is 18 feet long and 9 feet tall. Each bucket of paint covers 27 square feet. How many buckets will she need?
follow_up_questions: One bucket costs 15 dollars. How much does she spend on paint?

problem: One tin of varnish is enough for 27 square feet. A carpenter is varnishing a wooden deck 9 feet wide and 18 feet long. How many tins does he use?
follow_up_questions: If he pays 15 dollars per tin, what does the varnish cost him altogether?

problem: Find the area, in square feet, of a garden bed that measures 7 feet by 4 feet.
Grandpa built a kitchen table with a top 4 feet wide and 7 feet long. How many square feet does the tabletop cover?
Leila earned 36 dollars babysitting and 27 dollars walking dogs. She puts aside 7 dollars each week for swimming lessons. How many weeks of lessons can she pay for?
follow_up_questions: Her grandfather gives her 14 more dollars. How much money does she have altogether now?
Still spending 7 dollars a week, how many weeks will her money last now?
She spends 11 dollars on new goggles. How much money is left?

problem: For how many weeks can Kwame pay a weekly music fee of 7 dollars if he earned 27 dollars raking leaves and 36 dollars washing cars?
follow_up_questions: A neighbor pays him 14 dollars more for shoveling snow. What is his total now?
How many weeks of the 7-dollar fee can he cover with all his money now?
After buying a songbook for 11 dollars, how much money remains?

problem: Diego has 24 dollars at the fair, and each ride ticket costs 3 dollars. How many tickets can he buy?
follow_up_questions: He uses 2 tickets on the bumper cars. How many tickets does he still have?

problem: Fancy pencils cost 3 dollars each at the school store. If Amara spends all of her 24 dollars on them, how many pencils does she get?
follow_up_questions: She gives 2 pencils to her brother. How many pencils does she keep?

problem: Kenji had 13 marbles in a jar. At the park he found 6 more. What is the total number of marbles he has?
How many coins are in Fatima's piggy bank now, if it held 13 coins before she dropped in 6 more?
A train pulled out of the station carrying 45 riders. After 20 minutes, 18 riders stepped off at a small town. How many riders were still on the train?
follow_up_questions: At the following station, 9 more riders climb aboard. How many riders are on the train now?
At the final station, half of the riders leave. How many are still on board?

problem: How many campers stayed on the bus? It left school with 45 campers, drove for 20 minutes, and then 18 campers got off at the lake.
follow_up_questions: Another 9 campers get on at the next stop. How many campers are on the bus now?
At the camp gate, half of the campers get off. How many are still on the bus?

problem: A grocer had 16 boxes of apples and gave 7 of the boxes to a school. There are 12 apples in every box. How many apples are in the boxes he kept?
follow_up_questions: A chef buys 25 apples from those boxes. How many apples remain?

problem: Every carton at a toy warehouse holds 12 yo-yos. The warehouse had 16 cartons, then shipped 7 of them to a store. Work out how many yo-yos are in the cartons still at the warehouse.
follow_up_questions: Workers take out 25 yo-yos for a school fair. How many yo-yos are left in the warehouse?

problem: A music teacher divides 20 students into 4 equal bands. How many students are in each band?
follow_up_questions: Then 3 more students join every band. How many students does each band have now?
How many students are in the bands altogether now?

problem: There are 4 groups at a science camp, all the same size, with 20 campers in total. What is the size of one group?
follow_up_questions: Each group welcomes 3 new campers. How many campers are in each group now?
What is the total number of campers in the groups now?

problem: Mr. Okafor brought 22 cupcakes to the bake sale. At the end of the day he had 4 left. How many cupcakes did he sell?
How many balloons were given away at the fair if the stall started with 22 balloons and finished with only 4?
Sana has 40 dog treats and gives her puppy 4 each day. How many days will the treats last?
follow_up_questions: At the pet store she buys 12 more treats. For how many extra days can she give the same number each day?

problem: For how many days will a pack of 40 food pellets last if the class goldfish gets 4 pellets every day?
follow_up_questions: The teacher adds a small pack of 12 pellets. How many more days of feeding does that give at the same daily amount?

problem: A farm stand had 85 ears of corn at sunrise. By sunset 38 ears were still in the bin. How many ears did shoppers buy?
follow_up_questions: The next day at noon, 19 ears from the bin are sold. How many ears are in the bin now?
The farmer then adds 24 freshly picked ears to the bin. How many ears are in the bin now?
Counting the noon sales, how many ears of corn have been sold in all?

problem: How many programs were handed out at the school concert if 85 were printed and 38 were left on the table afterwards?
follow_up_questions: At the second concert, 19 of the leftover programs are handed out. How many are left on the table?
The office prints 24 more programs and puts them on the table. How many programs are on the table now?
Including the second concert, how many programs have been handed out altogether?

problem: A climbing gym charges 15 dollars for each child. If 12 children from a scout troop go, what is the total cost?
Find the total price for 12 campers to take a kayak lesson that costs 15 dollars per camper.
Mei walks 9 blocks to school each weekday. On Saturday she walks 14 blocks more than that. What is the total of one weekday walk and the Saturday walk?
follow_up_questions: On Sunday she also walks 6 blocks. How many blocks has she walked altogether?

problem: How many laps does Luca swim on Monday and Friday combined? On Monday he swims 9 laps, and on Friday he swims 14 laps more than on Monday.
follow_up_questions: He swims 6 more laps on Saturday. How many laps is that in total?

problem: An oak tree had 17 sparrows in its branches, and then 26 more sparrows flew in. How many sparrows are in the tree now?
follow_up_questions: Then 12 sparrows fly away. How many are still in the tree?

problem: At the beginning of recess 17 children were on the playground. Soon 26 more ran outside to join them. What is the number of children on the playground now?
follow_up_questions: When 12 children go back inside, how many stay on the playground?

problem: A zoo has 14 animal houses. On a 3-hour trip, Mr. Haddad's group missed 5 of them. How many animal houses did the group visit?
follow_up_questions: Another group visited 4 fewer animal houses than Mr. Haddad's group. How many did that group visit?
Adding up both groups' visits, how many animal houses were visited altogether?

problem: How many rides did the scouts try at the fair? The fair has 14 rides, and during their 3-hour stay the scouts skipped 5.
follow_up_questions: A family tried 4 fewer rides than the scouts. How many rides did the family try?
How many rides did the scouts and the family try in total?

problem: An apartment building has 7 floors, and each floor has 9 apartments. How many apartments are in the building?
follow_up_questions: 4 apartments are being repaired. How many apartments can still be rented?

problem: A parking garage has 9 parking spots on each of its 7 levels. What is the total number of spots?
follow_up_questions: Workers block off 4 spots for repairs. How many spots can drivers still use?

problem: The Tigers won the spelling contest with 67 points, finishing 12 points ahead of the Lions. What was the Lions' score?
follow_up_questions: In a bonus round the Lions earn 15 more points. What is their score now?
The Tigers now have 78 points. By how many points do the Lions trail?

problem: How many points did the Rockets score in their basketball game, if the Comets won with 67 points and were 12 points ahead?
follow_up_questions: The game goes on, and the Rockets add 15 more points. What is their total now?
By then the Comets have 78 points. How far behind are the Rockets?

problem: A pet store keeps 24 hamsters, 17 parrots and 31 goldfish in 3 rooms. How many pets does the store keep?
follow_up_questions: This week 9 of the pets are sold. How many pets are left?
A delivery brings 14 new pets. How many pets does the store have now?
A worker cleans the cages of 25 pets in the morning. How many pets are still waiting to have their cages cleaned?

problem: How many animals live on the farm? Across its 3 barns there are 31 goats, 24 sheep and 17 pigs.
follow_up_questions: The farmer sells 9 animals at the market. How many animals are left on the farm?
Then 14 newborn animals arrive. How many animals are on the farm now?
The vet visits and checks 25 animals before lunch. How many animals have not been checked yet?

problem: A coach gave out 18 team shirts to be signed by the players. So far 11 shirts have come back. How many shirts are still out?
Out of 18 library books lent to a class, 11 have been brought back. What number of books have not been returned yet?
A painter takes 9 brushes from a box of 52. How many brushes are still in the box?
follow_up_questions: Later he puts 4 brushes back. How many brushes are in the box now?
How many brushes has the painter kept out of the box for good?

problem: There were 52 bricks in a pile until a mason carried 9 of them away. What number of bricks remained in the pile?
follow_up_questions: She returns 4 bricks to the pile in the afternoon. How many bricks are in the pile now?
How many bricks did the mason end up keeping away from the pile?

problem: At the orchard, the apple trees gave 74 fruits and the pear trees gave 52. How many more apples than pears were picked?
follow_up_questions: The pickers find 18 more pears. How many pears have been picked in total?

problem: Find how many more strawberries than blueberries were collected at the farm, if the children gathered 74 strawberries and 52 blueberries.
follow_up_questions: Later they gather another 18 blueberries. What is the total number of blueberries collected?

problem: A zookeeper counted 21 monkeys in an enclosure. 12 were adults and the rest were babies. How many babies were there?
follow_up_questions: Then 5 more babies were born. How many babies are in the enclosure now?
How many monkeys are in the enclosure now, adults and babies together?

problem: There were 12 red cars and some blue cars in a parking lot, 21 cars in all. Work out the number of blue cars.
follow_up_questions: 5 more blue cars park in the lot. How many blue cars are there now?
What is the total number of cars in the lot now, red and blue together?

problem: A delivery van makes 6 drop-offs and spends 3 minutes at each. It then spends another 9 minutes at the warehouse. How many minutes is the van stopped altogether?
What is the total time Grandpa spends resting on his walk if he rests 3 minutes at each of 6 benches and then 9 minutes at the cafe?
A school gym has 9 rows of bleachers, and each row seats 12 people. How many people can sit in the gym?
follow_up_questions: At a game, 37 seats are empty. How many seats are filled?

problem: How many chairs are in a concert hall that has 12 chairs in each of its 9 rows?
follow_up_questions: During a recital, 37 of the chairs are not used. How many chairs have someone sitting in them?

problem: A craft cupboard holds 64 items. 23 of them are pairs of scissors and the rest are art supplies. How many art supplies are in the cupboard?
follow_up_questions: Of the art supplies, 17 are crayon boxes. How many art supplies are not crayon boxes?
A teacher puts 9 more crayon boxes in the cupboard. How many crayon boxes are there now?
How many items are in the cupboard now?

problem: How many pieces of equipment in the sports closet are bats or rackets, if the closet holds 64 pieces and 23 of them are balls?
follow_up_questions: Of those bats and rackets, 17 are rackets. How many are bats?
The coach brings in 9 new rackets. How many rackets are in the closet now?
What is the total number of pieces of equipment in the closet now?

problem: A bakery sold 42 loaves of bread in a week. Its oven is painted bright red. How many loaves did it sell each day on average?
follow_up_questions: The next week it sold 14 fewer loaves. How many loaves did it sell that week?

problem: How many letters did the mail carrier deliver to the farm per day, on average, if she delivered 42 letters there over a week? She drives a blue truck.
follow_up_questions: In the following week she delivered 14 fewer letters to the farm. How many letters did she deliver that week?

problem: Ayesha has 12 stickers. She buys 4 sheets of stickers with 8 stickers on each sheet. How many stickers does she have now?
follow_up_questions: She gives 15 stickers to her cousin. How many stickers does she have left?
Then she buys 2 more sheets. How many stickers does she have now?

problem: How many crayons does the art room have now? It had 12 crayons, and then the teacher opened 4 new boxes holding 8 crayons each.
follow_up_questions: Students take 15 crayons home. How many crayons are left in the art room?
The teacher opens 2 more boxes. How many crayons are there now?

problem: There were 14 books on Ana's shelf before she placed 5 more there. How many books does the shelf have now?
What is the total number of fish in the tank after a pet shop worker adds 5 fish to the 14 already swimming there?
A bus has 48 seats, but 75 students need a ride to the museum. How many students will not fit on the bus?
follow_up_questions: A second bus picks up 20 of them. How many students are still waiting?

problem: There are 75 children who want to join a summer camp, but it has room for only 48. How many children are left out?
follow_up_questions: A nearby camp accepts 20 of them. How many children still have no place?

problem: During the book drive, Ms. Lee's class brought 31 books, Mr. Diaz's class brought 26 and Mrs. Park's class brought 17. How many books were collected in all?
follow_up_questions: The librarian sends 40 books to a children's hospital. How many books are left?
A parent donates 13 more books. How many books are there now?

problem: How many bottle caps did the art club collect if Jamal found 17, Rosa found 31 and Tim found 26?
follow_up_questions: The club uses 40 caps for a mosaic. How many caps are left?
Someone drops off 13 more caps. How many caps does the club have now?

problem: A movie ticket costs 14 dollars. Mr. Novak buys 6 tickets for his family. What is the cost of the tickets?
follow_up_questions: He pays with 90 dollars. How much change does he receive?
Popcorn is 3 dollars a bag, and he buys one bag for each ticket. How much does the popcorn cost?
How much did he spend on tickets and popcorn altogether?

problem: How much do 6 passes to the water park cost when each pass is 14 dollars?
follow_up_questions: The passes are paid for with 90 dollars. What change comes back?
Each pass holder also rents a locker for 3 dollars. How much do the lockers cost?
Find the total cost of the passes and the lockers.

problem: Zara practised piano for 8 minutes on Monday, 5 minutes on Tuesday and 9 minutes on Thursday. How many minutes did she practise on those days?
follow_up_questions: Her teacher asked for 40 minutes of practice this week. How many minutes does she still need?
On Saturday she practises 11 more minutes. How many minutes does she still need now?

problem: Ivan does puzzles from a puzzle book. Find how many he solved on Monday, Wednesday and Friday together if he solved 9 on Friday, 8 on Monday and 5 on Wednesday.
follow_up_questions: The puzzle book has 40 puzzles. How many has he not solved yet?
He solves 11 more on Sunday. How many puzzles are still unsolved?

problem: A museum has 75 old coins. It lends 28 of them to another museum. How many coins does it still have?
follow_up_questions: The other museum sends 10 coins back. How many coins does the first museum have now?

problem: How many chairs are left in the town hall after 28 of its 75 chairs are lent to the school next door?
follow_up_questions: The school brings back 10 chairs. How many chairs does the hall have now?

problem: Ellie had some crackers in a box. She ate 9 of them, and now 31 crackers are left. How many crackers were in the box to begin with?
follow_up_questions: Ellie puts 12 new crackers into the box. How many crackers are in it now?
How many more crackers are in the box now than at the very beginning?

problem: How many beads were in the jar at first, if 31 beads were left after Lin used 9 for a bracelet?
follow_up_questions: Lin pours 12 new beads into the jar. How many beads does the jar have now?
Compared with the start, how many more beads are in the jar now?

problem: A bike shop pays 38 dollars for a used bike and sells it for 59 dollars. How much money does the shop earn on the sale?
Jaya bought a lamp at a yard sale for 38 dollars and later sold it online for 59 dollars. What was her profit?
Kofi and Mira walk to school together. Kofi has eleven toy cars and Mira has six. How many toy cars do they have in total?
follow_up_questions: Together they buy 5 more toy cars. How many toy cars do they have now?

problem: How many tomato plants are in the garden? Mr. Reyes planted eleven and his daughter planted six. The garden is behind their house.
follow_up_questions: They add 5 more tomato plants. How many tomato plants are in the garden now?

problem: Hugo has 9 seashells. Rina has 14 seashells and collects 6 more. How many seashells does Rina have now?
follow_up_questions: Rina gives 8 seashells to Hugo. How many seashells does Rina have left?
Hugo started with 9 seashells. How many does he have after Rina's gift?

problem: Pia wins 6 more marbles, adding to the 14 she already has. Her brother Sven owns 9 marbles. What is Pia's number of marbles now?
follow_up_questions: Pia hands 8 of her marbles to Sven. How many marbles does Pia keep?
Sven had 9 marbles before. How many marbles does he have now?

problem: A baker needs to put 54 cookies into boxes that hold 6 cookies each. How many boxes does she need?
follow_up_questions: She sells 4 boxes to a school. How many cookies does she still have?

problem: How many packs can a store make from 54 juice boxes if every pack has 6 juice boxes?
follow_up_questions: The store sells 4 of the packs. How many juice boxes are still in stock?

problem: Each of the 5 rows in the marching band has 6 drummers. The parade starts at the park. What is the total number of drummers?
follow_up_questions: 8 more drummers join the band. How many drummers are there now?

problem: How many dancers are on the stage, standing in 5 lines of 6 dancers each? The stage curtain is purple.
follow_up_questions: Another 8 dancers come onto the stage. How many dancers are on stage now?

problem: A yellow school bus has 36 seats, and a red city bus has 24 seats more than that. How many seats are on the red bus?
follow_up_questions: A green bus has 15 fewer seats than the red bus. How many seats does the green bus have?
How many seats do all the buses have together?

problem: How many pages are in Tom's big storybook if it has 24 more pages than his small storybook, which has 36 pages?
follow_up_questions: His comic book has 15 fewer pages than the big storybook. How many pages does the comic book have?
What is the total number of pages in the storybooks and the comic book together?

problem: Of the 85 flowers in a garden, 38 are tulips and 27 are daisies. The others are roses. Find the number of roses.
How many green marbles are in a bag of 85 marbles if 38 are red, 27 are blue and all the others are green?
A classroom has 5 bookcases with 8 books on each one. A box can hold 12 books. How many books are on the bookcases?
follow_up_questions: Students borrow 17 books. How many books are still on the bookcases?

problem: How many plants are on the windowsills, if there are 5 windowsills with 8 plants on each? A watering can holds 12 cups of water.
follow_up_questions: The gardener moves 17 plants outside. How many plants are still on the windowsills?

problem: In 3 hours, Aunt Mariam baked 45 dumplings for a family dinner, and everyone together ate 28. How many dumplings were not eaten?
follow_up_questions: The next day the children eat 6 more. How many dumplings remain?
What is the total number of dumplings eaten so far?

problem: How many cookies were left after the school picnic? The cook made 45 cookies, the picnic lasted 3 hours, and the students ate 28 cookies.
follow_up_questions: Teachers eat 6 more cookies after the picnic. How many cookies are left now?
How many cookies have been eaten altogether?

problem: Raj had some stamps in an album. After he gave 14 stamps to his classmates, 36 stamps remained. How many stamps did the album hold at first?
follow_up_questions: His uncle gives him 25 stamps. How many stamps does Raj have now?
He uses 30 stamps on letters to his pen pals. How many stamps are left?
Altogether, how many stamps has he given away or used?

problem: How many tokens did Grace have at the start? She gave 14 tokens to her brother and was left with 36.
follow_up_questions: Her mother gives her 25 more tokens. How many tokens does she have now?
She uses 30 tokens on games. How many tokens does she have left?
How many tokens has she given away or used in all?

problem: A gardener spreads 63 kilograms of soil evenly into 7 planters. How many kilograms go into each planter?
follow_up_questions: She takes 5 kilograms out of each planter. How many kilograms are left in each one?

problem: If 63 liters of water are shared equally among 7 identical buckets, how many liters end up in one bucket?
follow_up_questions: Then 5 liters spill from each bucket. How many liters are left in each bucket?

problem: Omar keeps 12 pebbles and 8 seashells on his desk. His aunt mails him 5 more seashells from her holiday. How many seashells does Omar have now?
follow_up_questions: He gives 4 seashells to a friend. How many seashells does he have left?

problem: How many comic books does Lucia own after her cousin gives her 5 more? She had 8 comic books and also 12 board games.
follow_up_questions: She donates 4 comic books to the library. How many comic books does she have left?
